# gitmoap_group_branch_rule (Data Source)

Get a group branch rule by ID. One of the group's own branch rules, with its settings and whether it is enforced on everything beneath the group. Anyone who can see the group may read it.

The token needs `branch_rule:read`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `branch_rule_id` (String) Branch rule ID
- `group_id` (String) Group ID

### Read-Only

- `allow_force_push` (Boolean)
- `allowed_to_merge` (String)
- `allowed_to_push` (String)
- `branch_pattern` (String)
- `enforcement` (String) Whether the scopes beneath may replace a rule, or only strengthen it.
- `merge_allowlist` (List of String)
- `push_allowlist` (List of String)
- `require_code_owner_approval` (Boolean)
